headline: Will the Tisza Government Tax Wealth That Doesn't Even Exist? – Entrepreneur Sends Open Letter About Wealth Tax
summary: Bitrise co-founder Barnabás Birmacher argues the government's announced wealth tax could seriously endanger Hungarian startups. In an open letter he says it could create payment obligations on paper-only wealth.
why: Tax policy on founders and private wealth affects startup funding, talent retention and capital formation in the venture ecosystem.
